raw.query: SELECT c.run_id, c.gpu_hours, l.p99_ms FROM provenance.v_pool_cost c JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l ON c.run_id = l.run_id AND c.pool = l.pool WHERE c.experiment = 'planner' AND c.is_current = true AND l.is_current = true AND l.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND c.run_id IN ('planner:week_fc_p90_toto', 'planner:week_fc_p90_timesfm')
raw.observed: Toto: 625.27 GPU-hours, TimesFM: 641.08 GPU-hours; both at 651.14 ms TTFT p99
raw.claimed: Toto/TimesFM pass at 651ms TTFT p99; costs 625/641 GPU-hours respectively
raw.evidence: The prior verifier mistakenly checked the a12 experiment; the planner experiment week runs (is_current=true) perfectly back the rounded 651 ms TTFT tail and costs of 625 and 641 GPU-hours.
